Figure 2:EmoReward calibrates emotional evidence within videos and across training runs.Plan translates intent into evaluation criteria, and Act obtains provider scores and evidence validity.
Reflect combines current-video gates with memory-derived multipliers and normalizes over active providers.
Evolve estimates contextual reliability from a completed reference run to construct the fixed multipliers
used in subsequent training. The calibrated emotion reward complements the original video reward;
GRPO updates the generator while the providers and memory table remain frozen.
Figure 3:EmoReward in performance scenes.Eight curated generated clips, each shown as three chronological full frames, illustrate expressions, gestures, and staging.
Figure 5:Ablation of provider-pool construction.Three frames per clip compare four configurations on the same prompt. See AppendixHfor quantitative results.

Figure 6:Interface for ordinal human evaluation.The interface presents the prompt and generated video with independent ratings of emotional fidelity, temporal coherence, and visual quality, each using three ordered categories: Bad, Normal, and Good. This reconstruction illustrates the reported rating protocol rather than the original data-collection interface.
